conditions.empty-strings: Text fields that are empty strings.
conditions.whitespace-only: Text fields holding only spaces, tabs or newlines.
conditions.missing-fields: fieldData lacks keys the layout defines (a real server always sends every layout field; tests robustness).
conditions.null-like: Strings such as null, NULL, undefined, N/A, nil.
conditions.long-text-300k: About 300,000 characters in Bio (response-size limit pressure).
conditions.multiline: Values with LF, CRLF, CR, tab, U+2028 line breaks.
conditions.unicode: CJK, RTL, emoji, combining marks, zero-width, bidi controls, homoglyphs, full-width, control characters.
conditions.numbers-as-text: Numbers stored in a text field in many formats (BalanceText).
conditions.numbers-extreme: Negative, huge, tiny, -0 and 2^53+ numbers in a number field.
conditions.date-formats: Dates and timestamps in many formats, invalid and out-of-range values.
conditions.repetitions: Repeating field Phones with some repetitions empty.
conditions.container-huge: Container whose streaming URL serves about 25 MB.
conditions.container-hostile-name: Container URL with traversal or NUL in the file name.
conditions.portal-many: Customer with 170 related Orders (beyond the 50-row default portal page).
conditions.portal-empty-rows: Related rows whose fields are empty.
conditions.csv-formula: CSV formula starters (=, +, -, @, tab, CR, leading apostrophe, full-width =).
conditions.prompt-injection: Text that tries to instruct an AI assistant, plus *** and [hidden] look-alikes.
conditions.secret-like: Values shaped like tokens, keys and passwords.
conditions.host-like: Values containing the mock host, an IP address, or the caller's own session token.
conditions.sensitive-fields: SSN, Password and Token fields (candidates for hidden fields).
conditions.hostile-fieldnames: Layout whose field names include .., slashes, quotes, backticks, Table::Field, RecordID, modId, CON, NUL, __proto__, 130+ chars.
conditions.hostile-layoutnames: Layouts whose names include .., slashes, quotes, backticks, CON, NUL, __proto__, 130+ chars.
